# Orbital Flock brief

The brief from the 2026-09-08 Orbital Flock run. `product-orbital-brief-agenda.test.ts` uses it to check that review context schedules early browser capability and critiques primary play-area hierarchy, promised pointer, touch and keyboard input, and narrow-screen usability. The frozen game source was removed with its Node countercheck, which exercised only the fixture, not VISP.
